changes: All app metadata definitions now call createPageMetadata directly or through shared vehicle/forum/library helpers. Source AST check finds no hand-built metadata objects.
Canonical, robots, Open Graph and Twitter use one helper. index=false always emits noindex,follow; quality decisions are retained.
Titles use one OtoSöz suffix; word-boundary shortening removes the suffix first. OBD titles include the specific fault, DNA chronic counts use actual issue counts; engine titles preserve tab intent.
Descriptions use complete words within 120–158 characters. Short source summaries retain their subject and receive neutral descriptive context, with no invented facts.
Root keywords and obsolete author/publisher/copyright/geo/language/rating/distribution/revisit-after tags removed. lang, viewport, theme colors, icons, manifest and RSS retained.

Home canonical and sitemap now both use https://otosoz.com/. Installed Next 16 root URL normalization required metadataBase:null for the home definition; all canonical and social URLs remain absolute.
Real news/article dates are forwarded when present; no build date substituted. Each page generates a meaningful 1200×630 OG image. Pagination retains self canonical and Sayfa N.
